summary.root_cause_text: payment_provider_url was changed live (not via a deploy) from internal://payments-v1 to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable, so the worker processed orders without payment.
recommended: Find out who changed payment_provider_url to payments-v2, and why the change isn't in recent_changes.
Check that payments-v2 is reachable before trying it again.
Add an alert on payment provider call failures, which are only logged at DEBUG.
